def recs(fn):
 a=[]
 with open(fn) as f:
  while (h:=f.readline()): a.append((f.readline().strip(),f.readline().strip(),f.readline().strip()))
 return a

print('E in M',sum((E&M).values()), 'N in M',sum((N&M).values()))
# score coordinate based estimate across every cut [possible exo start min,max]
# parse SAM starts and CIGAR primary alignment
import subprocess
starts={}
for x in 'exo endo mix'.split():
 out=subprocess.check_output(['samtools','view',x+'.sorted.bam'],text=True)
 starts[x]=[int(z.split('\\t')[3]) for z in out.splitlines()]
print('ranges',*(f'{x}:{min(v)}-{max(v)}' for x,v in starts.items()))
lo=min(starts['exo']); hi=max(starts['exo'])
for pad in [0,5,10,20,30,40,50,100]:
 l=lo-pad; h=hi+pad
 po=sum(not(l<=x<=h) for x in starts['endo'])/len(starts['endo'])
 obs=sum(not(l<=x<=h) for x in starts['mix'])
 est_endo=obs/po
 print('pad',pad,'window',l,h,'endodiag',po,'mixdiag',obs,'exo_frac',1-est_endo/len(starts['mix']))
